task_description: Address KiroCrew issue #8082: MCP Tool Search deferred tools stay permanently unavailable in a session even after /compact reduces context below the deferral threshold. The deferral engine is upstream in kiro-cli (far side of the ACP boundary); KiroCrew's only lever is the per-session Tool Search overlay it writes into <work_dir>/.kiro/settings/cli.json. Implement the achievable in-repo fix: a per-session escape hatch (AcpProvider.reload_tool_search) that rewrites the overlay and restarts the kiro-cli backend so deferral is recomputed against the current post-compact context, re-injecting previously deferred specs. Document the remaining upstream-only work for a maintainer.

verification.summary: Provisioned the >=3.12 venv (Python 3.12.13) via `make backend`. `.venv/bin/python -m pytest test/test_acp_tool_search_reload.py test/test_acp_tool_search.py -q` -> 43 passed (7 new + 36 existing). flake8 clean (rc=0) and isort clean on the new test file and acp.py. Test quality confirmed by mutation: removing the threshold rollback in reload_tool_search's except block makes test_restart_failure_rolls_back_thresholds fail (assert 42 == 7), proving the test exercises the new code path. Docker build skipped: no live kiro-cli backend is available in the sandbox and verification is host-side pytest with a mocked AcpClient, matching the repo's existing Tool Search test approach. Upstream-only portion (kiro-cli auto re-injection after /compact) documented in UPSTREAM_NOTES.md referencing issue #8082.
